meta.parties: Raki Et Al. v. Casie Lebbe Et Al

rules.statement: A seizure of land by the Fiscal amounts to dispossession, and gives a cause of action under section 5 of the Civil Procedure Code.
rules.supporting_quote: "I entirely agree with the forcible remarks of the District Judge as to the need for caution on the part of courts of law, in seeing that the conditions which can alone render an action quia timet competent to suitors exist before such actions are entertained. Nor do I think that it is possible, or desirable to attempt, to lay down any general rules as to the classes of cases in which such actions are maintainable. Each case must be decided on its own merits and special facts."
